summary: Frontend and integration test of the 4 questionnaire dropdowns on /inscricao.html and the blue card h3 fix. PASS: 4 required <select> elements (select-estado-civil, select-tipo-ensino-medio, select-uf-ensino-medio, select-ano-ensino-medio) with placeholder 'Selecione' and exactly the requested options, styled exactly like Sexo (48px height, 15px font, same border and background). 0 radio inputs remain. Desktop 1920 grid: the row-1 selects both have top=815 and the row-2 selects both have top=916, so they are aligned. Mobile 390: all selects have left=45 and width=300, same as Sexo, with no overflow. PASS: #btn-salvar stays disabled with 0, 1, 2 or 3 selects filled, becomes enabled at 4, and is disabled again when one select is reset. PASS: the flow inscricao -> dados -> confirmacao shows c-estado-civil, c-tipo-em, c-uf-em and c-ano-em correctly, including long values such as 'Mato Grosso do Sul, Mato Grosso, Goiás, Distrito Federal'. Returning to /inscricao.html restores all 4 values. PASS: confirmacao card is above the 'CONFIRMAÇÃO DOS DADOS' h2 and has the same left and width (444/1032). PASS: admin cadastro modal (btn-exibir-cadastro) shows Estado Civil, Tipo de ensino médio, Estado do ensino médio and Ano do ensino médio. FAIL then FIXED by me: on inscricao-realizada and pagamento-pix the h3 was still invisible. The JS fix stopped the h3 being removed, but an inline CSS rule '.blocoPadrao h3 { display: none !important; }' still hid it. After my one-line fix in build_pages.py and a rebuild, the h3 is visible on all pages at desktop and mobile.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED BY TESTING AGENT: the h3 had display:none because of the inline CSS '.blocoPadrao h3 { display: none !important; }' from the backup pages. Added a replace in build_pages.py that changes it to '.blocoPadrao h3:not(.vn-keep)', then rebuilt.

The row 'Estado da Prova' shows 'Ceará', and build_pages still reports 'ceará'/'seduc' leftovers in confirmacao. Pre-existing and outside this task, but inconsistent with Vestibular Unesp.

rca of the issue: There were 2 hiding mechanisms in the backup pages (confirmacao, inscricao-realizada, pagamento-pix): the JS __fgv_nuke_empty, already fixed with :not(.vn-keep), and the CSS rule '.blocoPadrao h3 { display: none !important; }', which was not fixed. confirmacao was not affected because its card is not inside .blocoPadrao. Fix: build_pages.py now also rewrites the CSS rule to '.blocoPadrao h3:not(.vn-keep)'.
